Still rerolling seeds and hoping the motion lands just right?
I made this short film with Code2Video to see what happens when code directs the motion. In each frame, the code calculates where the tip of the last spinning arm lands. The trail it leaves becomes the drawing.
Motion you can edit: Change a few numbers and the light traces a different shape.
Sound you can time in code: You can set a note to play at a specific point in the motion.

🎬 Watch the full 24-second film above.
